title: スマホとネットの安全
subject_en: Simple flat icon-style illustrations about online safety, each ONE separate object centred in its cell, bold shapes with a limited palette of blue, orange and cream; symbols only, no readable text Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: スマホ・鍵・盾・警告など、ネットの安全や情報管理を表すアイコン12点の素材です。社内研修の資料や注意喚起のページに使えます。
items: a smartphone with a padlock on its screen
a shield with a check mark
an old-fashioned key with a round head
a warning triangle with an exclamation mark
an envelope hanging from a fishing hook
a small box with a row of dots and a cursor
a wifi signal symbol with a small padlock
a cloud with an arrow pointing up
a magnifying glass over a keyhole
two circular arrows around a small gear
a raised palm inside a circle with a bar
three simple person icons connected by lines
